scope: Rigorous release validation. Reports identify the exact source revision and distinguish automated, live, and lab evidence.

golden_dataset.kind: Researched synthetic scenarios with primary-source references
golden_dataset.limits: Targeted behavior and lexical assertions; not clinical certification or exhaustive semantic acceptance

codeql.scope: The report identifies its exact analyzed commit

data.kind: Modeled outdoor estimate, not an indoor or street sensor measurement

genai.integration: Server-side Google Gemini; optional OpenAI support
genai.limits: Availability and factual accuracy require live evaluation; curated safety responses are labeled

privacy: Raw diagnostics and submission administration are kept outside the public checkout.

lighthouse.scope: One emulated-mobile lab run; challenge evaluation is separate.
